County 2013 not-on-ballot list (11052013_final_list_of_qualified_candidates..., inventory/elections/county/), text lines 989-1004: "WILLIAM S. HART UNION HIGH SCHOOL DISTRICT Vote for no more than 3 ... *CHRIS A. FALL Appointed Incumbent ... *BOB JENSEN CPA/School Boardmember ... *JOE MESSINA Incumbent ... 8/2/2013".

CEDA 2013 (raw CEDA2013Data.xlsx, all LA County rows): no Hart contest in 2013; Messina has rows only for 2003, 2005, 2007 (lost), 2009 (elected, 7,239), 2018 (elected, 10,236), 2022 (elected, 12,552).

Perry Smith, KHTS, "Hart District Required to Fill Vacant Seat by Appointment," SCVNews.com, 1 Oct 2013: "Fall resigned one week after the county's filing deadline for candidates, but the election had already been cancelled because there were no challengers for the three incumbents." and "the governing board must appoint a third member ... The appointment process is mandated by Education Code 5328." The appointment it describes is Fall's replacement (Robert Hall), not Messina.

Leon Worden, Hart board roster, hartschoolboardmembers.htm (legacy mirror), board of 12-11-2013 to 11-30-2014: "Joseph V. Messina {relected/unopposed 2013)"; board of 12-9-2009: "Joseph V. Messina (elected 2009)".

Education Code 5328 (leginfo, read 5 Oct 2026): "If pursuant to Section 5326 a district election is not held, the qualified person or persons nominated shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board, or if no person has been nominated or if an insufficient number is nominated, the governing board shall appoint a qualified person or persons ... and such appointee or appointees shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board as if elected at a district election."
holdings.correct: Keep that no election was held. Replace "appointed" in selectionMethod label and footnote: the nominee was seated without an election (Education Code 5328). Recommended value: a school-board option such as "seated-unopposed", labelled "Seated without an election as the only nominee"; evidence certified where the County names the person, derived where it names only the seat. For Messina: "Seated unopposed on 11 December 2013; the County cancelled the 5 November 2013 election for the three at-large seats (Education Code 5328)."
holdings.note: No source shows anyone appointing Messina. The County cancelled the election, and under Education Code 5328 an unopposed nominee is seated, not appointed. The governing board appoints only when too few people are nominated, which is what it did for Fall's seat (Hall, 16 Oct 2013). Nathan is right that Messina was never appointed. He was not elected at a held election in 2013 either: no votes were cast. The footnote's "..." joins the clause for nominees ("shall be seated at the organizational meeting") to the clause for appointees ("as if elected"), and that misquotes the statute.
